name: kvprefixes
description: The reserved-prefix write rule, per shim-writable prefix. Carried because the shim-writable allowlist is the one guard each engine enforces from its own copy of a list — the worker from `rove-reserved`, the replay prelude from a fragment generated off it — and those copies drifted once (rove#499: `_export/` was writable in prod and refused in replay). This case is what executes the pairing at runtime; the build-time assert in epilogue.zig only proves the two lists agree, not that a handler writing one of those prefixes actually replays.
